candidate.name: Levuka
candidate.note: town: UNESCO World Heritage colonial port town on Ovalau's east coast, Fiji's first capital (1874-1883); colonial architecture and Mission Hill views (Wikivoyage Levuka).

candidate.name: Levuka Town Hall
candidate.note: civic building: 1898 Town Hall housing the Levuka Town Council, built in honour of Queen Victoria's Diamond Jubilee (Wikipedia Levuka); no known public interior.

candidate.name: Niukaubi Hill War Memorial
candidate.note: monument: one of Levuka's two war memorials, on Niukaubi Hill north of town (Wikivoyage Ovalau).

candidate.name: Queen Victoria Memorial Hall
candidate.note: civic building: memorial hall on Ovalau named in Wikivoyage's See list; it is the same kind of colonial hall as the Levuka Town Hall (Wikivoyage Ovalau), public access unconfirmed.
